title: The Expedition That Watched a Comrade Turn Into a Human Ice Statue
hook: In -60°C temperatures, a man's sweat froze instantly, encasing him in a shell of ice as his friends watched.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visual horror of a person literally becoming an ice sculpture is unforgettable and highly shareable.
